architecture_overview:
The architecture leverages existing libraries and frameworks to minimize custom implementation:
- Use Python's built-in profiling libraries (cProfile) with sandbox wrappers
- Integrate with existing src/sandbox/exec_sandbox.py for secure code execution
- Extend current logging framework with structured debugging decorators
- Build on existing monitoring infrastructure with standardized configs
- Reuse constitutional validation patterns from src/sdd/validators.py

phases.name: Determinism & Debugging
goals: Establish deterministic execution and structured debugging (Beaver Method).
testing_strategy: Unit tests for determinism utilities with 80% coverage
Integration tests with existing sandbox components

phases.name: Profiling & Monitoring
goals: Add sandboxed AI code profiling and continuous quality monitoring configs.
testing_strategy: Integration tests with real code execution

phases.name: Production Deployment
goals: Provide load balancing, scaling, and regional deployment templates.
